text:
Olivia M: Hey all — clearing out some office stuff: a fully assembled Jarvis 48" sit-stand desk (oak top), a Logitech MX Master 3S mouse (like new), and two free GA tickets to the Bay Lights art opening next Wed. Prefer pickup SF office but can drop at mailroom. First-come, first-served.

Sam: Interested in the desk if it's still available. Any scuffs on the top? Can I see dimensions?

Olivia M: @Sam the top has one tiny nick on the corner (not visible when positioned). It's 48x30, electric motor works fine. Happy to leave it partly disassembled for easier transport.

Rory: I'll take the mouse if no one else wants it. Can grab today after lunch.

Olivia M: @Rory mouse yours — I'll leave it on the left bench with a Post-it "Rory".

Sam: For the desk, I can bring help to move it. Would prefer fully assembled. Can pick up Friday afternoon.

Alex - Facilities: FYI if you leave the desk in storage B I can have two folks and a trolley ready at 3:30 on Friday. Recommend labeling the parts if you partially disassemble.

Olivia M: @Sam sounds good. I'll leave the top intact and we can meet 3:30. @Alex please reserve the trolley.

Sam: Confirmed. I'll DM my truck size just in case. Thanks!

Alex - Facilities: Trolley reserved for 3:30 Friday. I'll put a sticky note on storage B with instructions.

Olivia M: Tickets are still available — first reply after this gets them. Prefer to transfer via email.

Rory: If nobody claims the tickets, I'll take one for a friend.

Sam: I'll pass on the tickets; need the desk more than a night out.

Olivia M: Okay summary: desk -> @Sam (pickup Fri 3:30, @Alex assisting), mouse -> @Rory (left bench), tickets -> first to reply after this (none claimed yet). I'll update if anything changes. Thanks! :sparkles:
